versions.title: Versions

intro.first: The first version is the model as downloaded.
intro.each: Each version below it stores only what its training changed.
intro.any: Any version can be made active at any time. Rolling back is making an older version active.

versions.onlyBase: Train the model to add versions here.

kind.lora: Change on top of the base

size.change: {size}, which is {percent} of the full model

menu.activateHint: Conversations will use this version. Rolling back is making an older version active.

rename.title: Rename version
rename.name: Name
rename.nameRequired: Enter a name for the version.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.body: The version is removed from the tree. Versions trained from it move up to its parent.

export.title: Export {name}
export.intro: Choose a format. The export is prepared in the background.

lora.name: LoRA adapter
lora.explain: The change alone, as a zip file. For vLLM and PEFT.

merged.name: Merged model
merged.explain: The full model with the change folded in, as large as the base model. Works with any engine.

gguf.name: GGUF file
gguf.explain: One file for llama.cpp and Ollama, with a Modelfile.

export.noChange: A base model has no change to export. It can be exported as a GGUF file.

quality.label: Size and quality
quality.q8_0: About half the size, nearly the same quality

exports.title: Exports of {name}
exports.intro: Files made from this version, newest first.
exports.emptyHint: A version can be exported to run on another engine.
exports.folderNote: A merged model is as large as the base model, so it stays on the server.
exports.removeBody: Its files are deleted from the server. The version itself stays.

failure.training_parts_missing: The components needed to prepare this export are not installed on this machine.
failure.converter_unavailable: The GGUF converter could not be downloaded. Check the internet connection and try again.
failure.conversion_failed: The conversion to GGUF failed. llama.cpp may not support this model.
failure.out_of_memory: This machine ran out of memory while preparing the export.
failure.nothing_to_merge: This version has no change to merge into the base model.

changes.title: What changed in {name}
changes.base: This is the model as downloaded. Nothing has changed, so there is no map.
changes.scratch: This version is the whole model, designed from scratch. There is no change to show.
changes.missing: No record of what changed in this version.

leading.attention: The biggest change is in the attention modules.
leading.feed_forward: The biggest change is in the feed-forward modules.
leading.even: Attention and feed-forward modules changed about equally.

changes.intro: Each square is a part of the model. A stronger colour means training changed it more.
changes.caption: Change by layer and module

errors.root_version_kept: The base model stays in the project.
errors.active_version_kept: The active version stays. Make another version active first.
errors.not_exportable: The base model is not on this machine, so this version cannot be exported.

attention.explain: The part of each layer that lets the model look at the other words in the text. Its modules are q_proj, k_proj, v_proj and o_proj.

feed_forward.explain: The part of each layer that processes every word on its own after attention. Its modules are gate_proj, up_proj and down_proj.

rank.explain: How large a LoRA add-on is. A higher rank can learn more and takes more disk space.
